single-event:
rule suspicious_lsass_access {
  meta:
    author = "SOC"
    severity = "HIGH"
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_ACCESS"
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\lsass\.exe$/ nocase
  condition:
    $e
}
match-window:
rule repeated_failures {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 5m
  condition:
    #e > 5
}
host-binding:
rule host_binding {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  condition:
    $e
}
target-principal-binding:
rule target_principal_binding {
  events:
    $a.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_ACCESS"
    $a.principal.hostname = $host
    $b.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $b.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 5m
  condition:
    $a and $b
}
dual-binding:
rule dual_binding {
  events:
    $a.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $a.principal.ip = $ip
    $b.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $b.principal.ip = $ip
  match:
    $ip over 5m
  condition:
    $a and $b
}
match-host-10m:
rule match_host_10m {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  condition:
    $e and #e > 3
}
match-user-5m:
rule match_user_5m {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user
  match:
    $user over 5m
  condition:
    $e and #e >= 5
}
match-ip-1h:
rule match_ip_1h {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.ip = $ip
  match:
    $ip over 1h
  condition:
    $e and #e > 10
}
threshold-3:
rule threshold_three {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "A"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 5m
  condition:
    $e and #e >= 3
}
threshold-10:
rule threshold_ten {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "A"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  condition:
    $e and #e > 10
}
threshold-inclusive:
rule threshold_inclusive {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "A"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 1h
  condition:
    $e and #e >= 2
}
outcome-count:
rule outcome_count {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:
    $attempts = count($e.metadata.event_type)
  condition:
    $e
}
outcome-dcount:
rule outcome_dcount {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:
    $users = count_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
  condition:
    $e
}
outcome-max:
rule outcome_max {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:
    $max_port = max($e.principal.port)
  condition:

outcome-min:
rule outcome_min {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m

outcome-sum:
rule outcome_sum {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:
    $bytes = sum($e.network.sent_bytes)
  condition:
    $e

outcome-avg:
rule outcome_avg {
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:

rule outcome_array_distinct {

    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 10m
  outcome:

outcome-array:
rule outcome_array {

    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:

  outcome:

meta-rich:
rule meta_rich {
  meta:
    author = "SOC"
    description = "Suspicious process"
    severity = "HIGH"
    mitre_attack_tactic = "Credential Access"
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_ACCESS"
  condition:
    $e
}
meta-custom:
rule meta_custom {
  meta:
    author = "SOC"
    priority = "P1"
    source = "endpoint"
  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_ACCESS"
  condition:
    $e
}

rule condition_event_count {

  match:

    $e.principal.hostname = $host
  match:
    $host over 5m
